name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1920: He asked why the board says 118 of 135 at 87 percent while the game shows 85, and then asked the harder question - where is the watchdog that should catch this automatically. It did not exist. Every Chronicle page carries a completion bar, the readers have photographed it for months, and nothing ever compared it to the board tally. His own two sentences settled the arithmetic that no gate did: 19 missing and 116 of 135, which sum exactly and give 85.9 percent, truncated by the game to 85 - so the denominator is right and the board was two over. The new reader takes the bar gold fill as a fraction of its track, structurally, with no OCR and no model call, and it runs on every sweep. It is a watchdog and not a counter and says so, with a tolerance wider than its own error and tighter than the gap that matters, and silence is reported as unknown rather than agreement.
